headline: Fusion CX Q2FY27 Results: PAT jumps 292% YoY
summary: Fusion CX Ltd reported a consolidated net profit of ₹586.33 million for Q2FY27, up 31% QoQ and 31% YoY. Revenue rose 22% YoY to ₹5,252.86 million. Board recommended ₹0.75 final dividend.

headline: Beekay Steel Q2FY27 Results
summary: Beekay Steel Industries reported a 57.6% YoY rise in Q2FY27 revenue to ₹419.4 crore. Net profit stood at ₹12.5 crore, impacted by treasury losses.

headline: Sarveshwar Foods grants ₹25 crore loan to subsidiary
summary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited entered an unsecured loan agreement of up to ₹25 crore with its subsidiary, Sarveshwar Overseas Limited, for general corporate purposes.

headline: Tamil Nadu Telecom Q2FY27 Losses Widen to ₹44.9 Lakh
summary: Tamil Nadu Telecommunications Ltd reported a standalone net loss of ₹44.9 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹42.98 lakh in the year-ago quarter. Revenue from operations remained negligible at ₹250.

headline: Coal India files RHP for MCL IPO
summary: Coal India Ltd filed the Red Herring Prospectus for subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields Limited's proposed IPO on November 13, 2026. The offering involves selling up to 661.8 million equity shares.

headline: Ajax Engineering seeks shareholder nod for Joshipura
summary: Ajax Engineering Limited has issued a postal ballot notice for the appointment of Shishir Joshipura as Non-Executive Independent Director. Voting opens November 15.

headline: Avudari Engineering open offer sees zero tenders
summary: Zero shares were tendered in the open offer for Avudari Engineering Limited. Acquirers hold 70.03% post-offer, missing the 96.11% target.

headline: Nava Ltd restarts 60 MW Odisha power plant
summary: Nava Limited resumed operations of its 60 MW power plant in Odisha on November 14, 2026, following routine maintenance. The unit is part of a 150 MW aggregate capacity.

headline: Emami promoter releases pledged shares to banks
summary: Diwakar Finvest and Suraj Finvest released pledged Emami shares to DCB Bank, HSBC, and IDBI. Post-release, Diwakar's encumbered holding stands at 5.43% of total share capital.

headline: MTAR promoter pledges 50,000 shares
summary: MTAR Technologies promoter Kavitha Reddy Gangapatnam pledged 50,000 equity shares with 360 One Distribution Services on November 11, 2026.

headline: Veejay Lakshmi promoter J Anand acquires 11 lakh shares
summary: J Anand acquired 11,05,350 shares via inheritance from his late father. His holding rose to 48.66%, while the total promoter group stake remained unchanged at 63.83%.

headline: United Interactive Q2FY27 net profit falls 15.7% YoY
summary: United Interactive Ltd reported a 15.7% YoY decline in consolidated net profit to ₹57.08 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by higher employee costs and zero operational revenue.

headline: FGIS Q2FY27: Zero revenue, net worth eroded
summary: Fourth Generation Information Systems reported zero revenue for Q2FY27. Net worth is negative ₹261.57 lakh as accumulated losses exceed capital, triggering a going concern warning.

headline: Cyient DLM signs MoU with Hindustan Shipyard on electronics
summary: Cyient DLM signed an MoU with Hindustan Shipyard Limited to explore maritime and defence electronics collaboration. Areas include indigenization, power electronics and AI-enabled maintenance. No deal value was disclosed.

headline: Aspira Pathlab promoter adds 1,289 shares in open market
summary: Promoter Jay Arvind Bhanushali acquired 1,289 shares (0.01%) of Aspira Pathlab & Diagnostics Ltd through the open market on November 12, 2026, per a BSE disclosure. His holding rose to 7.29% from 7.28%, with total share capital unchanged.

headline: Aspira Pathlab promoter lifts stake to 7.31% in open market
summary: Promoter Jay Arvind Bhanushali acquired 1,599 shares of Aspira Pathlab & Diagnostics via open market on November 13, 2026. Holding rose to 7.31% from 7.29%, with total capital unchanged at ₹10,29,30,000.

headline: Srit India wins QR 50 million Ooredoo healthcare deal
summary: Srit India secured a healthcare managed services order from Ooredoo valued at approximately QR 50 million (₹1,289.3 million), with a project duration of 2 to 3 years.

headline: Century Plyboards promoter acquires shares in open market
summary: Promoter Prem Kumar Bhajanka disclosed open market share acquisitions on November 12 and 13, 2026. Aggregate promoter group holding rose from 71.88% to 71.91%. Total voting capital stayed at 222172990 shares.

headline: Promoter buys 10,000 Jaro Institute shares in open market
summary: Promoter Sanjay Namdeo Salunkhe acquired 10,000 equity shares of Jaro Institute of Technology Management and Research Limited via open market on November 12, 2025, taking holding to 1,24,00,579 shares, or 55.66%.

headline: Zydus Lifesciences subsidiary gets four USFDA observations
summary: Liqmeds UK, a subsidiary of Zydus Lifesciences, received four Form 483 observations from the USFDA following an inspection.

headline: Galada Power Q2FY27: Net loss at ₹10.07 lakh
summary: Galada Power and Telecommunication reported a net loss of ₹10.07 lakh for Q2FY27, with zero revenue from operations. Total expenses stood at ₹10.07 lakh for the quarter.

headline: Sammaan Capital Q2 profit edges up, revenue falls YoY
summary: Sammaan Capital reported Q2 consolidated net profit of ₹3.12 billion against ₹3.1 billion a year earlier. Revenue stood at ₹18.5 billion versus ₹22.5 billion in the year-ago quarter, with no drivers disclosed.

headline: Promoter pledges 12.52% of Indo Tech shares for ECB loan
summary: Shirdi Sai Electricals, promoter of Indo Tech Transformers, pledged 13,29,624 shares (12.52%) on November 12, 2026, for a USD 66,000,000 ECB facility. Encumbered holding after the pledge stands at 58% of total share capital.

headline: Ajax Engineering Q2FY27: PAT up 30.4%, revenue rises 9.5%
summary: Ajax Engineering posted Q2FY27 revenue of ₹487 crore, up 9.5% YoY, while net profit surged 30.4% YoY to ₹50.9 crore. SLCM market share expanded to 75.5% in H1FY27.

headline: Galada Power & Telecommunication approves Q2FY27 unaudited results
summary: Galada Power & Telecommunication's board approved unaudited results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company certified no material events under Regulation 30 of LODR for the period.

headline: Spice Islands exempt from RPT disclosure for Q2FY27
summary: Spice Islands Industries said Regulation 23(9) disclosure of related party transactions does not apply for Q2FY27 and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Paid-up capital and net worth were below thresholds as on March 31, 2026.

headline: TVS Srichakra Q2 net profit rises to ₹444 million, sales up
summary: Consolidated net profit rose to ₹444 million in Q2 from ₹110 million a year earlier. Revenue reached ₹12.73 billion against ₹9.3 billion, while EBITDA margin widened to 8.22% from 7.11%.

headline: Madhya Bharat Agro Q2 net profit rises to ₹778 million
summary: Madhya Bharat Agro reported Q2 net profit of ₹778 million against ₹305 million a year earlier. Revenue rose to ₹7.15 billion from ₹4.5 billion, and EBITDA margin widened to 26.70% from 13.74%, while EBITDA reached ₹1.91 billion.
